notes.title: Dark Nights with Poe and Munro launches
notes.notes:
Our 3rd FMV game, "Dark Nights with Poe and Munro" has just launched along with a new Dekker patient, and a new Dekker bundle!

Jump into 6 episodes of supernatural strangeness with The Shapeshifting Detective's radio hosts Poe and Munro, and meet up with a Dekker patient that just might hold the key to the Dekkerverse and ends the trilogy with a bang!

There's a 10% launch discount, and Dekker will be flying the 10% flag from tomorrow too, but you can gift friends a complete Double Dekker bundle (including Dekker and Poe and Munro) for 30% off right now to share the madness together :o

notes.title: Have You Played The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

FMV games were a largely antiquated genre for the longest time, relegated to niche games that only a few people fully embraced. However, YouTube and the popularity of horror games have allowed for games like Her Story and more recent mind-bending efforts like Simulacra to gain an audience. However the one that wrapped its tentacles around me was The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker, helped by an intriguing story and some spectacular performances.

(more…)

notes.title: The Shapeshifting Detective releases 6th November 2018!
notes.notes:
Yes, we made another FMV game... 

The Shapeshifting Detective is a supernatural noir murder mystery where you play as a detective who can shapeshift into other characters to unlock secret conversations and private encounters. 

The game stars Aislinn De'Ath (Doctor Dekker's Marianna) plus Rupert Booth and Anarosa de Eizaguirre Butler (Contradiction: Spot the Liar's Jenks and Emma) and features a whole host of brilliant new FMV actors and guest voiceovers including Jesse Cox and Tex Murphy!

Check out the trailer and full description on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898650/The_Shapeshifting_Detective/]The Shapeshifting Detective's Steam page[/url] where you can also enjoy a 20% pre-order discount!

notes.title: The Shapeshifting Detective - our next FMV game!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce our next FMV game - "The Shapeshifting Detective"
https://shapeshiftingdetective.com

• A large FMV world to explore
• Shapeshift into other characters, or be yourself
• Branching storyline - catch the killer, save the victims, or both? 

Thank you for all the positive feedback, constructive criticism and love (where provided ;-) as it has encouraged us to change focus to deliver a new game sooner rather than later. We love playing FMV games and are humbled to be able to make those games ourselves.

There. Will. Be. No. Text. Parser. :-o.

notes.title: 1.06 patch - The "brkn kyb8rd" update!
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES
Added "suggested questions" 

SUGGESTED QUESTIONS
There's now a new way to traverse the Dekkerverse...
1. Click the dropdown button at the right of the text box for suggested questions.
2. Click a question, watch the video.
3. Repeat.

Use the button as much as you like, or ignore it, it's up to you! Asking for suggested questions adds one to your hint tally, so if you don't type at all you're certain to pick up our 'hinty aftertaste' achievement.

At launch there are just under 1000 suggested questions available, which will  enable you to easily finish the game, leaving 500+ responses as keyboard 'easter eggs' if you want to find them.

We really hope this new input system makes the game more accessible, and gives veterans a good reason to head back to the couch for a replay too...

notes.title: 1.05 Patch
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES
Added Linux platform
Added subtitle hints for side patients
Added multi-language framework
Added many many more keywords and combinations

LINUX
We have tested multiple successful playthroughs on Ubuntu 16.04 LTS 64 bit so that's our recommended platform.

SUBTITLE HINTS
We've continued with subtitle hints for all the side patients so you can quickly enjoy those stories if you want to.

MULTI LANGUAGE
We've added multi-language support thanks to various members of the community with their translation offers. We are locking the keywords with this release (unless we've epically broken anything!) so they can be released into the wild for translation. If you'd like to help with this process let us know. 

Thanks again to everyone who has supported the game, greenlight voters, purchasers, testers, streamers, reviewers and fans. We'd like to say sorry to those players who couldn't live with the parser, and warmly hug those who enjoyed taking the journey with us - we'll be working on another FMV game for you soon...

notes.title: 1.04 Patch
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES
Added subtitle hints
Added new subtitle display option (on / off / replay)
Added cursor up / down question recall
Various keyword changes
Various note changes
Fix for playing with more than one monitor

SUBTITLE HINTS
When playing with subtitles on, this option highlights keywords and phrases that you should talk about. Subtitle hints are only available for required (amber) responses - green is still intentionally hard. We're defaulting to subtitle hints on for replay, but you can set your preferred combination in the options screen.

Typing *hint* should still remain 100% effective for progressing though! 

QUESTION RECALL
Up and down arrows now recall your most recent questions, so you can fix typos and add / remove words quickly.

notes.title: 1.03 update
notes.notes:
The 1.03 patch is incoming with the following notes...

NEW - replay game ending (available if you haven't started a new game)
NEW - windowed mode

and 

Increased *wait* time for multithread loading (fix for slower machines)
Repost achievements on launch (fix for any missing achievements)
Added app_id file to root directory (for linux testing)
Added / removed keywords and phrases for balancing 
Added GUI options for hardware flags and acceleration

------
Note for players running a BETA branch or using launch params:
You will need to reset these options after updating, available in the init.json file (browse local files option from Steam properties) or from the options screen in the GUI.

E.g.
{"hardwareAcceleration":true,"inProcessGPU":false,"windowStyle":"full"}

For no hardware acceleration:
"hardwareAcceleration":false

For the inProcessGPU launch parameter flags:
Remove the --params from your Steam game properties tab.
"inProcessGPU":true

If you have not been running a branch or using params - touch nothing :-o

notes.title: 1.02 update
notes.notes:
We've already shipped multiple content patches (see forum) but this is the first major engine change since 1.01 - so here are the notes!

- Reversed thread load order. 
Fixes problem for games installed on a slow HDD whilst the O/S is installed on an SSD.
- Updated help video
- Several forum led keyword improvements, more keywords and phrases added.
- More in-game notes.

Finally, Steam trading cards are now fully enabled.

notes.title: 1.01 update

The first Dekker update is incoming! Here's the notes:

- New help video
- Slider for background music
- Several forum led keyword improvements
- Prevention of accidentally choosing the answer to a yes/no type question before hearing the question.
- Fixed possible game freeze during save
- Fixed act 2 Jaya hint (from forum)
- Fixed potential continue problem when all suspects leave
- Added confirmation dialogue to continue button
- Reduce save game size to improve performance

Thank you for all your helpful feedback and suggestions so far!

notes.title: The Doctor will see you now!
notes.notes:
The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker has now launched!!!

If you're playing Dekker right now, or are about to play, please watch the help video - especially if you skipped through it at the start of the game!
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J-aPkfqaauE] Help Video [/url] 

TOP TIPS!
1. Replay responses with **
2. Use the same words as your patients
3. Include a 'yes' or 'no' with any answer you give
4. Type 'hint' - it's not a dirty word!

“The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker delivers a fresh, memorable, and intricately woven tale of psychological horror.”
- Kelsey Erwin, [url=http://opnoobs.com/reviews/indie/adventure/the-infectious-madness-of-doctor-dekker]Overpowered Noobs[/url]

"Doctor Dekker is utterly compelling. Excellent writing and performances. It's a shining example of the FMV format and deserves notice."
- [url=https://twitter.com/FMVWorld]FMV World[/url]

notes.title: Fhtagn motion video: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker coming May
notes.notes: It’s ’90s a go-go these days with new trashy first-person shooters, Infinity Engine-style RPGs, and adventure games from genre giants, but to me the epitome of the ’90s revival is these new FMV games. I’ve not had a disc drive in years but I can almost hear one spin up when I look at Contradiction, The Bunker, Late Shift, Her Story, or, right now, The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker [official site]. Due in May, it’s a “Lovecraftian” FMV murder mystery about a psychiatrist treating/interrogating patients/suspects to uncover who murdered their predecessor, the eponymous Doctor Dekker. Observe: … [visit site to read more]
